name: cure-ind-dock
note: L10 R3 warehouse (bld.cure-warehouse) dock side with the service building (bld.cure-service-building) at the real game camera: the courier stands in front of the dock platform. Run with --matrix (high/low tier, zoom 1 and 0.5). Look for: dock doors with yellow frames, platform edge, bumpers, canopy and posts, clerestory band, bollards, the service building's door and louvres, sunk or floating parts, flicker, missing parts at the low tier (LOD2).
